facts.subject: A17
facts.notes: Condition: Hydraulic pressure below 150 bar.

facts.subject: A17
facts.notes: Panel Indication: RED.

facts.subject: A17
facts.object_value: 1. IV-21 closed or partially closed; 2. Low hydraulic fluid; 3. Pressure sensor signal invalid
facts.notes: Possible causes listed in AEG-AL-700.

facts.subject: A17
facts.object_value: Execute Shutdown Procedure 4.7 if persistent > 10 seconds (close IV-21, confirm pressure decay, set POWER to OFF, tag out)
facts.notes: Transient A17 clears on own; persistent > 10s requires Shutdown Procedure 4.7.

facts.subject: AUX_RESERVOIR
facts.object_value: Auxiliary Reservoir is introduced in training deck as Line 4/5 specific detail for peak demand top-up; explicitly omitted from standard Operator Manual
facts.notes: Slide 2: 'tops up from a smaller Auxiliary Reservoir during peak demand. Note: Line 4/5-specific detail and is not covered in standard Operator Manual.'

facts.subject: HPU
facts.notes: Normal HPU discharge pressure setpoint revised from 180 bar to 200 bar effective SW 3.2.

facts.subject: HPU
facts.notes: Normal discharge pressure on revisions prior to 3.2 was 180 bar, measured by PS-04.

facts.subject: HPU
facts.notes: Informal observation by J. Torres using uncalibrated local gauge; recorded during normal operational run on Line 4 (field service notes). Preserved as field observation with low reliability.

facts.subject: HPU
facts.object_value: Units on software revision >= 3.2 manufactured after 2024. Units running earlier software operate at 180 bar.
facts.notes: ECN-1042 confirms higher setpoint applies to post-2024 Series-7 units on SW >= 3.2.

facts.subject: IV-21
facts.notes: Location specified in Component Register AEG-CR-700.

facts.subject: IV-21
facts.notes: MTBF / reliability engineering metrics are completely absent from documentation (Category A unanswerable).

facts.subject: PLC-03
facts.object_value: Hydraulic pressure must be below 50 bar. Do NOT reset while pressure > 50 bar.
facts.notes: Resetting under pressure (>50 bar) can cause uncommanded actuation of IV-21.

facts.subject: PLC-03
facts.notes: Direct purple lines connect PLC-03 to PS-04A and IV-21. HPU connects via grey fluid path.

facts.subject: PS-04
facts.object_value: NOT identical to PS-04A. PS-04A has updated signal conditioning to correct 18-month drift, requires FW >= 3.2, and is not a form-fit-function replacement.
facts.notes: ECN-1042 explicitly states PS-04A is not a form-fit-function replacement for PS-04.

facts.subject: PS-04A
facts.notes: ECN-1042 introduced sensor change from PS-04 to PS-04A effective SW 3.2.

facts.subject: PS-04A
facts.notes: Controller firmware must be revision 3.2 or later to read PS-04A correctly.

facts.subject: PS-04A
facts.notes: Screen displays 'P.S.04-A', which corresponds to canonical component PS-04A as printed on physical unit label.

facts.subject: PS-04A
facts.notes: Operating temperature for PS-04A is completely absent from all dataset documents (Category A unanswerable).

facts.subject: PS-40
facts.object_value: Located on Coolant Loop, Skid B. Completely unrelated to HPU discharge circuit. 0-10 bar sensor.
facts.notes: Explicitly marked unrelated to HPU circuit in component register and configuration export.

facts.subject: Q1
facts.notes: Incoming disconnect Q1 is rated for 480V 3-phase. 400V operation is not documented (Category C).

facts.subject: SW_3_2
facts.notes: Revision 3.2 released 2025-09-30. PS-04 replaced by PS-04A; pressure changed from 180 to 200 bar.

facts.subject: sensor_ps04a_threshold_bar
facts.object_value: Normal operating pressure (or normal HPU discharge pressure setpoint = 200 bar)
facts.notes: Corresponds to 200 bar normal operating pressure in Operator Manual Section 5.
